assessment.nobel_worthiness: KPZ supplied a remarkably simple universal mechanism for stochastic interface growth and has transformed non-equilibrium statistical physics.
assessment.attribution: Kardar and Zhang formulated the foundational universality class; Takeuchi supplied exceptionally persuasive quantitative experimental confirmation.
assessment.maturity: The theory is four decades old, mathematically and experimentally developed, and its universality is now firmly established.
uncertainties: The breadth of applications makes it difficult to define a single decisive experimental realization.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: DMFT made strongly correlated electrons quantitatively tractable and created a durable conceptual and computational framework.
assessment.attribution: Georges, Kotliar, and Vollhardt are central to the formulation and establishment of the method.
assessment.maturity: Its predictions and extensions have been tested across correlated materials over several decades.
uncertainties: The contribution is a powerful theoretical framework rather than one sharply bounded discovery.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Two-dimensional conformal field theory revealed an exact organizing structure at criticality, with exceptional conceptual reach.
assessment.attribution: The credited authors made the decisive foundational advances, though the intellectual genealogy of conformal methods is broad.
assessment.maturity: The framework has endured for decades and has repeatedly connected exact theory to critical phenomena.
uncertainties: Its relation to experimentally isolated physical discoveries is less direct than for some candidates.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: The jamming framework identified a general route to rigidity in disordered matter and unified granular, colloidal, and glassy systems.
assessment.attribution: Liu and Nagel gave the central formulation and made jamming a coherent physical problem.
assessment.maturity: A large body of simulations, theory, and experiments has established the phenomenon and its scaling structure.
uncertainties: The boundary between jamming, glass formation, and related rigidity transitions remains actively debated.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Flocking theory uncovered a distinctive non-equilibrium ordered state and provided a universal statistical-physics description of collective motion.
assessment.attribution: Vicsek established the influential minimal model, while Toner and Tu developed its decisive continuum theory.
assessment.maturity: The central predictions have stimulated extensive experimental and theoretical work across active matter.
uncertainties: Real biological collectives have mechanisms and interactions beyond the minimal universality class.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Topological insulators and the quantum spin Hall effect established a new robust class of quantum matter with striking observable consequences.
assessment.attribution: Kane and Mele provided the seminal theoretical construction; Molenkamp led a defining experimental realization.
assessment.maturity: The phase and its protected boundary transport are extensively replicated and understood.
uncertainties: The field overlaps conceptually with topological work already recognized by the Nobel Prize.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: These methods made reliable first-principles electronic-structure calculations practical for complex real materials, altering materials physics broadly.
assessment.attribution: Vanderbilt and Blöchl introduced key formal advances, and Kresse was central to their robust and widely used implementation.
assessment.maturity: The methods have been independently validated and used throughout computational condensed-matter science for decades.
uncertainties: The work is methodological, with credit distributed across a wider density-functional-theory tradition.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Programmable quantum simulators have provided unusually clean laboratory realizations of interacting many-body models.
assessment.attribution: Bloch pioneered optical-lattice quantum simulation, while Browaeys and Lukin made programmable Rydberg arrays powerful experimental platforms.
assessment.maturity: The platforms now demonstrate controlled many-body phenomena, although their most transformative uses may still lie ahead.
uncertainties: It remains uncertain whether a single discovery can encompass the distinct optical-lattice and Rydberg-array traditions.
